groups.title: Everest Base Camp Heli Tour: Day Trip

days.label: Day 1
days.text: Not everyone has the option of trekking to Everest Base Camp. Take a tour by helicopter. Our guide services begin at your hotel in Kathmandu and cover every detail of your day trip. The average duration of this Kathmandu-Everest-Kathmandu excursion is 5-6 hours, including KalaPathar, a panoramic breakfast, and lunch with your guide in Boudha.

highlights.title: Everest Views from KalaPathar
highlights.body: The approach to the region soars over the Khumbu Valley, landing atop KalaPathar. From within the region, the best views of Mount Everest are from KalaPathar, a slightly higher vantage point that Everest Base Camp. Our guides are attentive to your health and safety and will lead you on an experiential visit to the region based upon your comfort level at high altitudes. Kala Pathar is 18,519 ft above sea level.

highlights.title: Soar through the Himalayas
highlights.body: Experiencing the himalayas as you soar through valleys and around mountains between Kathmandu and Everest Base Camp is unique to the heli tour between the city and the Khumbu Valley.

highlights.title: Breakfast with Panoramic Views of Everest and Ama Dablam
highlights.body: After seeing Everest and the Khumbu Valley, the group will land above Namche Bazaar for breakfast with panoramic views of Ama Dablam and Everest in the distance. This is a great way to celebrate the experience and slow down for a few moments before heading back to Kathmandu.
highlights.imageAlt: Breakfast with Panoramic Views of Everest and Ama Dablam

included: Hotel pick-up and drop-off within Kathmandu
Accommodations: As a day trip, there are no accommodations included in this activity.
Meals: Breakfast/Tea/Coffee and Lunch are included in this day trip activity
excluded: Alcohol: We strongly encourage minimizing or eliminating alcohol while acclimatizing. Should you choose to drink alcohol when appropriate, you may do so but must pay your alcohol tab at the close of the meal.

Tips: It is customary to tip all senior guides, junior guides, and porters. We will provide information about the tipping culture in Nepal so you can make informed decisions regarding when to tip and how much to tip.
Clothing and Equipment: We do not provide your gear but do have a packing list to help you prepare. We are happy to answer any questions you have and make recommendations if you need assistance.
